site.title: Greece Public Health Early Warning & Surveillance

panels.sari_rate_by_age: SARI per 1,000 admissions, all ages and paediatric

subtitles.hospital_admissions: Weekly new {{pathogen}} admissions from EODY's active-surveillance network of 84 hospitals.
subtitles.hospital_admissions_Attica: Weekly new {{pathogen}} admissions from the {{location}} hospitals in EODY's 84-hospital active-surveillance network.
subtitles.icu_admissions: Weekly {{pathogen}} ICU admissions from EODY's comprehensive active surveillance of laboratory-confirmed severe cases.
subtitles.icu_admissions_a: Weekly Influenza A ICU admissions (all A subtypes) from EODY's comprehensive active surveillance of laboratory-confirmed severe cases.
subtitles.icu_admissions_b: Weekly Influenza B ICU admissions from EODY's comprehensive active surveillance of laboratory-confirmed severe cases.
subtitles.deaths: Weekly {{pathogen}} deaths from EODY's active mortality-surveillance system (laboratory-confirmed).
subtitles.test_positivity: Weekly % of all SARS-CoV-2 tests positive (RT-PCR + rapid antigen), National COVID-19 Registry.
subtitles.sari_positivity: Weekly % of SARI samples positive for {{pathogen}}, EODY 14-hospital SARI sentinel network.
subtitles.sari_positivity_Attica: Weekly % of SARI samples positive for {{pathogen}}, the {{location}} hospitals in EODY's 14-hospital SARI sentinel network.
subtitles.sentinel_positivity: Weekly % of ILI samples positive for {{pathogen}}, EODY primary-care sentinel network (~100 physicians).
subtitles.private_positivity: Weekly % of multiplex samples positive for {{pathogen}}, EODY's 7-private-hospital network.
subtitles.private_positivity_Attica: Weekly % of multiplex samples positive for {{pathogen}}, the {{location}} hospitals in EODY's 7-private-hospital network.
subtitles.sari_rate: Weekly SARI cases per 1,000 admissions ('Incidence' = SARI ÷ admissions × 1000) at EODY's 14-hospital SARI sentinel network. Multi-pathogen syndromic.
subtitles.sari_rate_Attica: Weekly SARI cases per 1,000 admissions ('Incidence' = SARI ÷ admissions × 1000) at the {{location}} hospitals in EODY's 14-hospital SARI sentinel network. Multi-pathogen syndromic.
subtitles.ili_rate: Weekly influenza-like illness (ILI) rate per 1,000 sentinel visits, population-weighted (ELSTAT 2011 census), EODY primary-care sentinel network (~100 physicians). National (no Attica breakdown). Multi-pathogen syndromic.
subtitles.ww_load: Daily composite samples from the Psyttalia WWTP (NKUA Analytical Chemistry lab), as weekly means; normalized to copies/100K inhabitants (Galani et al. 2022, §2.4).
subtitles.ww_flu_a_load: Daily composite samples from the Psyttalia WWTP (NKUA Analytical Chemistry lab), as weekly means; normalized to copies/100K inhabitants (Galani et al. 2022, §2.4).
subtitles.ww_flu_b_load: Daily composite samples from the Psyttalia WWTP (NKUA Analytical Chemistry lab), as weekly means; normalized to copies/100K inhabitants (Galani et al. 2022, §2.4).
subtitles.sari_rate_by_age: Weekly SARI cases per 1,000 admissions ('Incidence' = SARI ÷ admissions × 1000) at EODY's 14-hospital SARI sentinel network. Multi-pathogen syndromic.
subtitles.sari_rate_by_age_Attica: Weekly SARI cases per 1,000 admissions ('Incidence' = SARI ÷ admissions × 1000) at the {{location}} hospitals in EODY's 14-hospital SARI sentinel network. Multi-pathogen syndromic.

SARS-CoV-2.hospital_admissions: Weekly new {{pathogen}} admissions from EODY's active-surveillance network of 84 hospitals. Weeks prior to 2025-W44 come from EODY's prior all-hospital network.
SARS-CoV-2.hospital_admissions_Attica: Weekly new {{pathogen}} admissions from the {{location}} hospitals in EODY's 84-hospital active-surveillance network. Weeks prior to 2025-W44 come from EODY's prior all-hospital network.
